To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the development of the rules and principles of treaty making and of the law of treaties in general is an evolutionary process, which is still ongoing.

(a) treaties are the primary source of modern international law, (b) they are the primary instrument for ensuring stability in international relations, (c) their role has not changed through the centuries, but the contents of the agreements, the procedures for their making, and the rules for their interpretation have changed, and (d) the rules and procedures for making and interpreting treaties have been codified in the Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties.
treaties have been and remain the most important instrument of international relations and international law.
